objective: Theorem and exhaustive local verification. Define, for each far point, the gluing-line classes reached from its far base faces by switch rules, and the crossing knots they reach in one more step. Prove that this two-level rule gives exactly the crossing knots of the elimination closure, by showing that it contains the closure's Y-eliminations by construction and that every other elimination stays inside it on every local configuration: every complement-closed near relation on the gluing line and up to three further classes, with every far configuration of the four census far sides.
status: Proved by PENDANT-LINE-20261106-001A-P001: for every near side and the four census far sides, the crossing knots the elimination closure reaches are exactly those of a two-round rule at the gluing line (round one: {c, x, y} when some z on the line makes {c, y, z} a far knot and {x, y, z} a near knot; round two: near pairs sharing a round-one point, and two-far knots through a line point); proved by reduction to local configurations and an exhaustive check of all 348,376,032 of them; so the closure reaches its crossing knots in two rounds, through the gluing line alone
title: Creation is decided at the gluing line
